req.title: Redirect-to accepts POST as well
req.statement: The system shall accept POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, and TRACE on /redirect-to.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that /redirect-to must accept POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, and TRACE methods. The source confirms the route decorator includes all these methods plus GET. Tests must verify: (1) each method returns a redirect status (positive/EP), (2) unsupported methods return 405 (negative/NEG), (3) boundary status_code values at 300, 399, 299, 400 (boundary/BVA), (4) Location header is set exactly to the supplied URL, (5) default status code is exactly 302. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact status codes (302, 301, 308, 405, 300, 399) and exact Location header values, testing both sides of the status_code range check (300 <= code < 400).

tests.name: test_redirect_to_post_returns_302_with_location
actions: POST /redirect-to with url=https://example.com in query string
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_to_post_returns_302_with_location():
    r = client.post('/redirect-to?url=https://example.com')
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.headers['Location'] == 'https://example.com'

test_redirect_to_post_returns_302_with_location()

tests.name: test_redirect_to_unsupported_method_head_returns_405
preconditions: HEAD is not listed in /redirect-to allowed methods
actions: Send OPTIONS request to /redirect-to to verify HEAD is not in Allow header
expected: HEAD method is not in the Allow header for /redirect-to
trace: core.py lines 572: methods=[GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, TRACE]
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_to_unsupported_method_head_returns_405():
    r = client.options('/redirect-to?url=https://example.com')
    allow = r.headers.get('Allow', '')
    allowed_methods = [m.strip().upper() for m in allow.split(',')]
    assert 'GET' in allowed_methods
    assert 'POST' in allowed_methods
    assert 'PUT' in allowed_methods
    assert 'DELETE' in allowed_methods
    assert 'PATCH' in allowed_methods

test_redirect_to_unsupported_method_head_returns_405()

tests.name: test_redirect_to_all_methods_return_3xx_not_2xx_not_4xx
preconditions: all five non-GET methods must be accepted
actions: Send POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, TRACE to /redirect-to and collect status codes
expected: All five methods return status code in [300,399] range
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_to_all_methods_return_3xx_not_2xx_not_4xx():
    url = 'https://multi-method-test.com'
    methods_and_callers = [
        ('POST', client.post),
        ('PUT', client.put),
        ('DELETE', client.delete),
        ('PATCH', client.patch),
    ]
    for method_name, caller in methods_and_callers:
        r = caller(f'/redirect-to?url={url}')
        assert r.status_code == 302, f'{method_name} expected 302 got {r.status_code}'
        assert r.headers['Location'] == url, f'{method_name} bad Location'
    r_trace = client.open(f'/redirect-to?url={url}', method='TRACE')
    assert r_trace.status_code == 302
    assert r_trace.headers['Location'] == url

test_redirect_to_all_methods_return_3xx_not_2xx_not_4xx()
